name: Ourol (Spain)
description: Green field with a yellow band from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged with a yellow golden oriole with black wings in each of the two green areas.
history: In 2009 the municipal council, in ordinary session, agreed to modify the municipal arms and to create a municipal flag; the proposed flag is a green cloth with a yellow bend accompanied by a yellow golden oriole (Oriolus oriolus) with black wings in each space.

features.role: band from the upper hoist to the lower fly
two golden orioles (vichelocregos) with black wings
